mapper.select: SELECT hbm.agreement_id, hbm.agreement_num, (SELECT (SELECT DISTINCT (fe. NAME) FROM sys_user_allocation sua, fnd_employee_assigns fea, fnd_employee fe WHERE fa.created_by = sua.user_id AND sua.employee_assign_id = fea.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID AND fe.EMPLOYEE_ID = fea.EMPLOYEE_ID) upload_person FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam WHERE to_char(hbm.AGREEMENT_ID) = fam.table_pk_value AND fam.table_name = 'HLS_BP_MASTER_AGREEMENT' and fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and rownum=1) UPLOAD_USER_ID_N, (SELECT fa.creation_date FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam WHERE to_char(hbm.AGREEMENT_ID) = fam.table_pk_value AND fam.table_name = 'HLS_BP_MASTER_AGREEMENT' and fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and rownum=1) UPLOAD_DATE_N, ( SELECT wm_concat ( sf.FILE_NAME ) FROM fnd_atm_attachment sf, fnd_atm_attachment_multi sa WHERE sa.ATTACHMENT_ID = sf.ATTACHMENT_ID AND to_char( hbm.agreement_id ) = sa.table_pk_value AND upper( sa.table_name ) = 'HLS_BP_MASTER_AGREEMENT' ) file_names, hbm.description, hbm.enabled_flag, hbm.assure_manner, hbm.valid_from, hbm.valid_to FROM hls_bp_master_agreement hbm where hbm.bp_id = #{bpId}

select hbm.agreement_id, hbm.agreement_num, hbm.upload_user_id, hbm.description, hbm.enabled_flag, hbm.assure_manner, hbm.valid_from, hbm.valid_to from hls_bp_master_agreement hbm where hbm.bp_id = #{bpId}
